verdicts.title: Constructions of Rank-Metric Codes of Small Tensor Rank
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Rank-metric codes are subspaces of matrices over finite fields endowed with the rank metric and admit a natural tensorial representation. The tensor rank provides a measure of the minimal size of a decomposition of a code into rank-one tensors. verdicts.title: Tensor Representation of Rank-Metric Codes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present the theory of rank-metric codes with respect to the 3-tensors that generate them. We define the generator tensor and the parity check tensor of a matrix code, and describe the properties of a code through these objects.
